name: b3-bmg-p3p4
headline: Human Written
windows:
The leaf is strong enough that even picking one can affect me if the juice from the broken part touches sensitive skin, especially under my fingernails, so I keep my skin away from the broken end.
I've seen it work on someone else too: I once gave beach morning glory to a woman who was nauseous and miserable on a psychedelic, and within a couple of minutes she was very happy.
I was rushing to help her, so I may have given her more than I would give now.
